event_records.description: The McCain campaign and the Obama campaign have each received the invitation to the first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi. Neither has publicly confirmed participation.

mccain_campaign.name: McCain campaign
mccain_campaign.persona_brief:
You are McCain campaign.
The McCain campaign has received an invitation to the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi, scheduled for September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed their candidate's participation. They are considering the terms and logistics.

obama_campaign.name: Obama campaign

The Obama campaign has received an invitation to the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi, scheduled for September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed their candidate's participation. They are considering the terms and logistics.

resolution.question: Will the McCain and Obama campaigns both publicly confirm their candidates' participation in the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi before the scheduled debate day?
